afirmacao.passagem: Snake venom phospholipase A2 (PLA2) that induces myonecrosis, when intramuscularly injected into mice (PubMed:23509754). Does not show systemic myotoxic effect (after intravenous injection) (PubMed:23509754). Does not show cytotoxic activities in myotubes and myoblasts (PubMed:23509754). Induces marked paw edema after subplantar injections (PubMed:23509754). Also induces an increase in vascular permeability and in the levels of TNF, IL-6, and IL-1 cytokines (PubMed:23509754). causes enzymatic-dependent neuromuscular blockade in avian and mammalian neuromuscular preparations in vitro essentially by a presynaptic mechanism with no significant direct action on skeletal muscle function (PubMed:23541434, PubMed:25572337). PLA2 catalyzes the calcium-dependent hydrolysis of the 2-acyl groups in 3-sn-phosphoglycerides (PubMed:23509754)
